description: 管制事業、下水道系統許可、申報及查核處分資訊查詢平台 [sewerage and wastewater] is a dataset listed in Government Open Data Platform of Taiwan (data.gov.tw), an open data portal, published or maintained by 環境部. 提供水污染防治法管制之事業、下水道系統查核及處分資料查詢服務. Coverage: Taiwan. The portal files it under the publisher 環境部. Its tags are 生活安全及品質. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv, json, xml. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Chinese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is 政府資料開放授權條款-第1版. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support wastewater and sewer network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-tw-dgt-portal.
